bindings.variant: measure (CTC-first, geometric only on CTC miss)

findings: Speculative parallel geometric plus ignoring CTC TIMEOUT partials was waiting out the 200 ms proposal budget (mode 210–220 ms on the 17,945-row shard). Sequential CTC-first publishes those partials and skips geometric on a hit.
Same 50 shard-1 rows: fused_swipe 86%/90% vs CTC 84%/90% (was fused 50% top-1). p50/p95 185/235 ms (was 214/262). 12/50 over 200 ms (was 40/50). Geometric candidates in the fused slate on 1/50 rows.

Stage split: decode p50/p95 168.5/216.4 ms, fusion 8.9/57.5 ms (50 ms neural budget on cold rows), next-word ~0 ms. Remaining p95 over 200 ms is CTC decode through LiveSwipeModelSlot, not geometric wait.
scope: Diagnostic 50-row GrapheneOS check that sequential CTC-first removed the 200 ms wait. Not a Phase 0 matrix replacement.
